text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Having completed their New Year's card delivery work,
Karyl and {0} are strolling through
the bustling Landosol streets together.
text_block_list.orig_text:
年賀状配達の仕事を終え、
報酬を分け合ったキャルと{0}は
人で賑わうランドソルの街をぶらついていた。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
*sigh* I was hoping to relax at the start of the year,
but things sure got hectic.
text_block_list.orig_text:
は～、
年の初めはのんびりするつもりだったのに
慌ただしくなっちゃったわね。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
You're sorry? You don't have to apologize, you know.
I was the one who said I'd help, and I even took my cut.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ごめんなさい？　
別に
あんたが謝ることじゃないでしょ。
あたしが自分から手伝って、
分け前ももらったんだから。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
Hang out? Can't you see that I'm tired from working so hard...?
Ah, fine then. I did just get a fat wad of cash.
I can hang out for a little while.
text_block_list.orig_text:
遊ぶ？　
働いて疲れてるってのになんで……
まぁいいわ。
お金も入ったことだし、
ちょっとだけ遊んでいきましょ。

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text:
Come one, come all! Test your luck in our New Year's lotto!
We've got lots of fabulous prizes!
text_block_list.orig_text:
年末年始の運試しに
福引はいかがかね～！
いい賞品揃えてるよ～！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's right. When I bought those spellbooks,
I got a free raffle ticket.
I doubt I'll win anything, but might as well give it a go.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そういえば、
魔導書買ったときに
福引券もらってたわね。
どうせ当たらないでしょうけど、
引いてみましょうか。

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text:
Winner winner, chicken dinner!
Aren't you the lucky one, young lady?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
大当たり～！
特賞だ！　
すごいな、
お嬢ちゃん！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
You're kidding!
I did it! I wonder what the special prize is!
C-could it be a proper Tantalizing Tropical—
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほんとに！？
やったわね！　
特賞って何かしら！
ひょ、
ひょっとして
今度こそちゃんとした魅惑の南国……

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text:
Three months' worth of tasty mochi!
Each one is a little masterpiece, carefully crafted by artisans using the
highest-grade rice!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おいしいお餅、
３ヶ月分！
最高級のもち米を使って、
職人が丁寧に作り上げた逸品だよ！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
...Oh.
Come on, what am I supposed to do with three months' worth of mochi?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……微妙ね。
っていうか、
３ヶ月分もお餅もらってどうしろっていうのよ。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
If I was Pecorine, I'd be crying with happiness?
I guess if you think of it like that, it [i]is[/i] a pretty good prize.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ペコリーヌなら泣いて喜ぶか。
そう考えると
いい賞品ね。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
I mean, why do I have to think about her first?!
I'm the one who won the prize!
text_block_list.orig_text:
って、
なんで真っ先にアイツのこと考えなきゃいけないのよ！
あたしが当てた賞品よ！？

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
N-nothing's up with me!
Anyway, let's hurry and get that prize.
text_block_list.orig_text:
な、
なんでもないわっ。
それより
さっさと受け取っちゃいましょう。

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text:
The mochi will be mailed to you at a later date,
so you have something to look forward to!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お餅は
後日郵送されるから、
楽しみにしててね！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'm looking forward to it.
...Wonder how many days they'll last?
text_block_list.orig_text:
えぇ、
楽しみにしてるわ。
…………
餅が何日で消えるか。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
It may only be mochi, but a special prize is a special prize.
This year's already off to a great start!
text_block_list.orig_text:
賞品がお餅だったとはいえ、
特賞は特賞よね。
新年早々調子いいんじゃないかしら！

text_block_list.name: Vendor
text_block_list.text:
Limited edition New Year's grab bags! We're down to the last one!
The fun is in not knowing what's inside until you open it!
There's good fortune to be found in leftovers!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お正月限定福袋！　
ラスト一袋だよ～！
中身は
開けてからのお楽しみ～！
残り物には
福があるよ～！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
Hear that?! The last bag! We've gotta buy it!
I've got a feeling that we can get something real good!
Come on!
text_block_list.orig_text:
聞いた！？　
ラスト一袋だって！　
買うしかないじゃない！
今のあたしたちなら
いい物を手に入れられる気がするわ！
行きましょ！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Hey, that grab bag there—I'll take it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ねぇ、
その福袋
買うわ！

text_block_list.name: Vendor
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, thank you!
...Wait, hold on.
text_block_list.orig_text:
毎度あり！
……
って、
あら。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
What's the matter?
Get on with it please.
text_block_list.orig_text:
どうしたの？
早くちょうだい。

text_block_list.name: Little Girl
text_block_list.text: I want it too...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あたしも、
それ、
ほしい……

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
What? I'm not gonna let you have it just because you're a kid!
I was here first.
If you always get what you want, you won't grow up into a decent adult!
text_block_list.orig_text:
何よ。
子どもだからって譲らないわよ！
あたしの方が先だったんだから。
甘やかすとロクな大人にならないからね！

text_block_list.name: Little Girl
choice_data_list: She looks like she's about to cry.

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
I-I can see that!
I bet she came here with her New Year's money...
text_block_list.orig_text:
わ、
分かってるわよ！
きっと
お年玉握りしめて来たんでしょうね……

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
I can see that!
But she has to learn that crying will get her nowhere...
text_block_list.orig_text:
見れば分かるわよ！
けど
泣いたってどうにもならないってことも学ばないと……

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
Argh! Fine!
Whatever! I'll let you have the dumb grab bag!
Here, take it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あー！　
もう！
分かったわよ！　
この福袋は譲ってあげるわ！
受け取りなさい！

text_block_list.name: Little Girl
text_block_list.text: Are you sure...?
text_block_list.orig_text: いいの……？

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Yes, have it.
text_block_list.orig_text: いいわよ。

text_block_list.name: Little Girl
text_block_list.text: Thank you, miss!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ありがとう！
おねえちゃん！

text_block_list.name: Vendor
text_block_list.text:
All right, here you go.
The very last grab bag.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それじゃあ、
はい。
最後の
福袋だよ。

text_block_list.name: Little Girl
text_block_list.text: Thank you!
text_block_list.orig_text: ありがとう！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
H-hey.
Seeing as I let you have it, can I at least see what's inside?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ね、
ねぇ？
譲ってあげたんだからさ。
中身を見るくらいは、
いいわよね？

text_block_list.name: Little Girl
text_block_list.text:
Sure!
Let's open it together!
Ready...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
もちろん！
一緒にあけよう！
せーの！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: ...The heck is this?
text_block_list.orig_text:
…………何よ、
これ。

text_block_list.name: Little Girl
text_block_list.text:
A broken toy and...
some trash...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
こわれたおもちゃと……
ごみ……？

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
Something's wrong here.
Let's swap it for a decent one...
text_block_list.orig_text:
何かの間違いよね？
きちんとした福袋と交換を……

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
What?! The seller's gone!
Huh?! Was he a con man?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
って！！　
商人いなくなってるし！！
はぁ！？　
詐欺師だったの！？

text_block_list.name: Little Girl
text_block_list.text: But... my poor New Year's money…
text_block_list.orig_text:
あたしの、
お年玉……
どうなっちゃうの……

text_block_list.name: Little Girl
text_block_list.text:
...*whimper*
*whimper, whimper*... *sniff*
text_block_list.orig_text:
…………ぐすっ
う、
う……
すんっ。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
Great job holding back the tears.
Since it's come to this, for your sake, I'm gonna
find that dirty fraudster and ki—...
text_block_list.orig_text:
泣くのを我慢するのは偉いわね。
こうなったら、
あたしがあんたに代わって
あの詐欺師をブッこ……

text_block_list.name: Little Girl
text_block_list.text: And ki...?
text_block_list.orig_text: ブッこ……？

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: ...And catch him!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ブッ
捕まえてやる！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: I'm borrowing the grab bag.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょっと
福袋借りるわよ。

text_block_list.name: Little Girl
text_block_list.text: What for...?
text_block_list.orig_text: どうするの……？

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
The criminal has left a trail, so I'm gonna find him using search magic.
I'll make him regret ever making me angry!
text_block_list.orig_text:
犯人の痕跡が残ってるから
探査魔法で追うのよ。
あたしを怒らせたこと、
後悔させてやるんだから！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
All right, got him!
I'm going after him!
text_block_list.orig_text:
よし、
見つけた！
追うわよ！

text_block_list.name: Little Girl
text_block_list.text: Me too!
text_block_list.orig_text: あたしも行く！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
It's too dangerous for you, so wait here.
I promise I'll get your money back.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あんたは危ないから
ここで待ってなさい。
お金は必ず取り返してくるから。

text_block_list.name: Little Girl
text_block_list.text: Can I really not go with you...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
一緒にいっちゃ、
ダメ……？

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
It's too risky.
I'll be back before you know it, so hold tight.
text_block_list.orig_text:
危ないからダメよ。
すぐ戻ってくるから待ってなさい。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
I see him!
Over there!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いた！
あそこよ！

text_block_list.name: Vendor
text_block_list.text:
Erk!
What are you doing here?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ゲッ！？
どうしてここが！？

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
That's not important.
Give back that little girl's money right now!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんなことはどうでもいいから、
あの子のお金を返しなさい！！

text_block_list.name: Vendor
text_block_list.text:
What kind of idiot would just return the money when told to?
I'm outta here!
text_block_list.orig_text:
返せと言われて返す馬鹿がどこにいる！
あばよ！！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
Let's combine our strength so we can clean up this mess
in no time at all!
text_block_list.orig_text: あんたとあたしの力で一気に片づけちゃいましょ！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Eat this, scumbag!
text_block_list.orig_text: これでも喰らいなさい！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Aaaaaahhh!
text_block_list.orig_text: はぁぁあああ！！

text_block_list.name: Vendor
text_block_list.text: Nguaaaaaahhhhhh!
text_block_list.orig_text: ぐわぁあああああ！？

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
Hah! He was just a cream puff in the end.
All that's left is to get the money back, and hand him over to the
royal knights.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふんっ、
手ごたえのないやつ。
あとは
お金を取り戻して騎士団に引き渡すだけね。

text_block_list.name: Little Girl
text_block_list.text:
Wooow!
That was amazing!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わ～～！！
すごいすごい！！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
Huh? You...
I thought I told you to stay put because was dangerous.
text_block_list.orig_text:
って、
あんた……
危ないからついて来ないでって言ったのに。

text_block_list.name: Little Girl
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry...
text_block_list.orig_text: ごめんなさい……

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
I'm just glad you're not hurt.
Here, take this. It's your money.
text_block_list.orig_text:
怪我がなくてよかったわ。
はい、
これ。
あんたのお金。

text_block_list.name: Little Girl
text_block_list.text:
Thank you!
H-hey... Miss?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ありがとう！
ね、
ねぇ……
おねえちゃん？

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: What? Is there some cash missing?
text_block_list.orig_text:
何よ。
お金足りなかった？

text_block_list.name: Little Girl
text_block_list.text:
No, it's not that.
I, um...
text_block_list.orig_text:
んーん、
ちがうの。
えっと、
その……

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Come on, spit it out.
text_block_list.orig_text: 早く言いなさいよ。

text_block_list.name: Little Girl
text_block_list.text:
Do you think that if I try really, really hard,
I can be as cool as you when I'm older?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あたしも
頑張ったらおねえちゃんみたいに
かっこよくなれるかな？

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
Huh?!
C-cool? Me?
text_block_list.orig_text:
へっ！？
か、
かっこいい？　
あたしが？

text_block_list.name: Little Girl
text_block_list.text: Yeah!
text_block_list.orig_text: うん！！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
W-well! How should I know?
Maybe if you put in enough hard work, sure, you'll get to be like me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
さ、
さぁ？　
知らないけど。
でも、
たくさん努力すれば
なれるかもしれないわね！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Until she handed the con artist over to Nightmare,
Karyl was bombarded with questions about what to strive for,
all the while wearing a rather smug expression.
text_block_list.orig_text:
詐欺師を王宮騎士団に引き渡すまで、
何を努力すればいいのか質問攻めにあいつつ、
まんざらでもない表情を浮かべるキャルであった。
